command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_thermal.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Prescribed Q4 contact traces on a unit edge. For uniform conductance use q(s)=s-1/2; for graded conductance use q(s)=(1+s)*(s-5/9). Integrate the polynomial analytically on each side of its zero. Both full-edge signed integrals vanish while directional powers are finite. Check forward, reversed and zero fields, clipped subedges and zero width. Errors are maximum absolute power errors in W.
